description: COMBINE the run's best (9d38abc2: n=176 megakernel + n=352 mega_med + clustered two-level + geometric low-rank, geomean 45475) with brief-0's gap-aligned rank-peel (dc4a0c063). The peel is GATE-PASSING on rankdef512 (shape8, orth 6e-6, eigr 1.2e-3) and nearrank1024 (shape10) but ~15% too SLOW end-to-end (rankdef peel 192ms vs cuSOLVER 167ms), so brief-0 left it dormant — both shapes sit on the cuSOLVER floor. Lift the peel machinery (_eigh_gap_peel, _ns_orth_fp32, _lambda_max, the cheap bf16-sign-count gap detector) onto the best branch and make it WIN by cutting its dominant cost: the FP32 Newton-Schulz orthonormalization (~40ms, measured no-tensor-core SIMT). Replace it with TF32 tensor-core orthonormalization (brief-6 measured TF32 8-10x FP32-SIMT at relerr 2.9e-4, within the 0.6% orth gate) plus a single final cleanup, and/or brief-4's fp16-backtransform+1-NS cheap tail. Route ONLY the runtime-detected rank-deficient shapes (the bf16-sign-count gap detector fires on rankdef/nearrank, not full-rank dense) with per-matrix residual-gated cuSOLVER fallback so nothing regresses. Target: rankdef512 + nearrank1024 both < cuSOLVER, stacking ~4% onto the geomean. Verdict = full 13-shape geomean < 45475 + 39/39 idle-verified.

Integrate brief-0 gap-peel onto best branch, _PEEL_N={512,1024}, FP32-SIMT NS-orth (faithful integration). Regresses: shape8 rankdef 218ms, shape10 nearrank 144ms (both slower than cuSOLVER); validates 39/39. Confirms brief-0's dormant-peel starting point.

TF32 tensor-core NS-orth in peel. Worse (shape8 358ms): TF32 fails the internal orth gate at b640 (orth 1.1e-2 vs gate 4.6e-3) -> full cuSOLVER fallback ON TOP of peel. Diagnosis: NS orthonormalization floors at ~6e-3 (FP32)/1.2e-2 (TF32), can't clear the tight orth gate.

Lean peel: found+fixed the 50x trsm bug (solve_triangular on non-contiguous Q^T = 1074ms vs 19ms contiguous), block-L (null eigenvalues=0, skip full Rayleigh), route 768-signal-block through mega_med. mega_med block eigh EXPLODES shape8 to 1.7s (its internal residual gate + fallback). Regression.

kbig-exact range finder (drop +8 oversampling): the rank-kbig projector range with kbig+8 cols made the Gram singular -> cholesky fails -> whole-batch torch.linalg.qr fallback (1065ms). Exact-kbig cols keep CQR2 on its fast path. Also switched block eigh back to cuSOLVER (mega_med was the trial-3 explosion). shape10 nearrank 449->137ms; shape8 rankdef still 382ms (rare per-run cholesky failure still triggers whole-batch QR). geomean 51653.

Robust cholesky_ex CQR (per-matrix re-shift, NO whole-batch QR fallback) fixes the rankdef512 explosion. Re-aimed per manager: gate peel to n=1024 ONLY (drop rankdef512 -> brief-7 owns it via low-rank). shape8 back on cuSOLVER floor 167ms (byte-identical routing); shape10 nearrank 138ms (still > cuSOLVER 108ms). geomean 47180.

Trimmed peel: fold range-finder+subspace step, build null block as the orthogonal COMPLEMENT of Qb (avoids 2nd Pnull projector+subspace), null eigenvalues via cheap diag(Qn^T A Qn) Rayleigh (not full-Q A@Q). shape10 nearrank 138->122ms; shape8 on cuSOLVER floor. geomean 46719. Still > cuSOLVER on shape10.

Peel DORMANT (_PEEL_N empty) -> branch behaviorally == parent, no regression (geomean 45489 == parent 45475). Established the true cuSOLVER floors: shape10 nearrank 107739us, shape8 rankdef 167227us. Confirms peel is a loss on nearrank (122ms vs 108ms).

Single-pass FP32 CQR (passes=1) in peel: 2nd CQR pass didn't improve final orth (both ~8.3e-3, binding error is TF32 projection/FP16 sign, not CQR conditioning), so 1 pass halves cost at no accuracy loss. Re-enabled _PEEL_N={1024}. Microbench 95ms (WIN vs cuSOLVER 105ms) but live L2-flushed benchmark shape10=114ms (loss). geomean 46392.

TF32 residual gate (gate GEMMs Q^T Q + A@Q on tensor cores, only feed a pass/fail threshold so TF32 is fine; thresholds tightened 70/140). shape10 nearrank live 115ms — still ~7% > cuSOLVER-on-nearrank 108ms. Root cause: cuSOLVER already exploits rank-deficiency (nearrank cuSOLVER 108ms < dense-1024 cuSOLVER 120ms via cheaper laed3), and L2-flush penalizes the peel's larger footprint. geomean 46401.

FINAL: peel DORMANT (_PEEL_N empty) -> branch behaviorally identical to parent 9d38abc2 (geomean 45517 == 45475 within noise, 39/39, no stream, -O2). VERDICT: gap-peel cannot beat cuSOLVER on nearrank1024 (768-dim flat signal block irreducible + cuSOLVER already exploits rank-deficiency). Machinery fully wired, isolated, reseed-safe (all fixes preserved: contiguous-RHS CQR2 50x bugfix, robust cholesky_ex, single-pass CQR, complement-null, block-Rayleigh, TF32 gate) for a deeper-deficiency reseed or manager redirect.

Combined brief-0 gap-peel onto best branch (9d38abc2) and drove it to its speed-of-light on the benchmark's rank-structured shapes. VERDICT: the peel CANNOT beat cuSOLVER on nearrank1024 (best ~115ms live vs cuSOLVER 108ms, ~7% loss) — irreducible: signal block after peeling is 768-dim/dense/FLAT (PR 326/768, no internal gap, not low-rank) so block cost is cuSOLVER(768)=67ms, AND cuSOLVER already exploits rank-deficiency (108ms nearrank < 120ms dense-1024 via laed3). rankdef512 dropped per manager (brief-7 owns it). 11 trials: (1) faithful FP32-SIMT integration=49641; (2) TF32 NS-orth=53450 fails orth gate; (3) mega_med block explodes to 1.7s; (5) found+fixed the 50x solve_triangular non-contiguous-RHS bug (1074ms->19ms) + kbig-exact range finder; (6) robust cholesky_ex CQR replacing whole-batch QR fallback + gate to n=1024; (7) trimmed peel (complement-null, block-Rayleigh); (9) single-pass CQR=95ms microbench WIN but 114ms L2-flushed live; (10) TF32 gate; (11 FINAL) peel DORMANT -> geomean 45517==parent 45475, 39/39, no regression, no stream, -O2. Branch is a CLEAN dormant graft (n=176/352/clustered/geometric/low-rank untouched, byte-identical). OPEN: a reseed with deeper null (signal<=0.5n) flips the peel to a large win (machinery wired+reseed-safe, add n to _PEEL_N); the contiguous-RHS CQR2 bugfix + robust cholesky_ex could be grafted onto brief-7's low-rank CQR2 and the two-level CQR2 to cut their trsm cost. Recommend keeping the no-regression dormant graft or redirecting; do not judge the peel dead — it is correct and gate-passing, just outrun by cuSOLVER at 0.75n deficiency.
